releaseNotes:
• Added Full-Screenshot Vision Mode (enabled by default): sends the full screen capture directly to Gemini/OpenAI/Claude so the AI reads chat bubbles, avatars, stickers, profiles & stories without OCR errors
• Automatically captures and analyzes dating profiles (Tinder/Hinge/Bumble bios & prompts) and Instagram/Snapchat Stories even when no chat bubbles exist
• Displays AI-detected target message in the overlay card ('Them (Screenshot Vision)')
• Added 'Full-Screenshot Vision Mode' toggle in Settings -> Screen Capture & OCR
